metrics.atomic: Each verifier determines boolean compliance; empty responses false
metrics.prompt_level: Count prompts whose all verifier entries pass / number of prompts
metrics.instruction_level: Sum passing entries / all instruction entries
metrics.loose: Any passing transformed candidate per instruction, eight candidates in current source (identity plus star/first/last/both combinations).

selected_examples.expected_behavior: Official instruction_id_list and kwargs, not a created unique answer; no generated answers or checker/model execution.

initial_results.trial_count: Repeated trial count not specified in source; no pass@k or single-run claim inferred.
